description: This source file defines the internal sealed partial class ActivationRebalancerMonitor, which implements monitoring and coordination logic for the activation rebalancer component within the Orleans distributed virtual actor framework. It manages reporting, rebalancing participation, listener notifications, and lifecycle event handling for the activation rebalancer.

classes.name: ActivationRebalancerMonitor
classes.description: The class monitors and manages activation rebalancer reports, lifecycle participation, and rebalancing coordination within an Orleans silo, utilizing timers and listeners to handle reporting and lifecycle events.

methods.name: Participation
methods.description: Subscribes the monitor to silo lifecycle events for start and stop handling.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Initializes the monitor, sets up timers to periodically check reports, and fetches initial report data.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the monitor stops, including potentially migrating the rebalancer if hosting.

methods.name: GetRebalancingReport
methods.description: Retrieves the latest rebalancing report, optionally forcing an update from the rebalancer grain.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Handles incoming rebalancing reports, updates internal state, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: SubscribeToReports
methods.description: Adds a listener to receive rebalancing report updates.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromReports
methods.description: Removes a listener from receiving rebalancing report updates.

methods.name: LogStartingRebalancer
methods.description: Logs a trace message indicating the rebalancer has not reported within the expected interval.

methods.name: LogMigratingRebalancer
methods.description: Logs a trace message indicating the rebalancer is migrating to another silo.

methods.name: LogErrorWhileNotifyingListener
methods.description: Logs an error if notification to listeners throws an exception.
